status: G5 pilot: processed, compressed and reviewed; ships as g5-cart-load, on the cart at Chapter III's station and Chapter VIII's ferry (desktop build, High)
use: The supply cart's load: on the cart's bed while the supplies are still to be recovered, gone once they are secured or lost. The redo of g5-cart-load.

generator.prompt: A heap of Roman army supplies lying directly on the ground: six bulging linen grain sacks tied at the neck, stacked four below and two above, two clay amphorae laid on their sides against the sacks and a coil of rope on top, the whole heap partly covered by a dark leather sheet lashed down with cords; about one point two metres long, nine tenths of a metre wide and sixty centimetres high, with a flat underside. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.

review.notes: Six bulging grain sacks in two layers under a dark leather sheet lashed with cords, a coil of rope and two amphorae laid on the top, on a leather ground sheet: no cart. Processed at 0.75 m high so its 0.98 by 0.94 m footprint fills the cart's 1.03 by 1.35 m bed; the decimator stopped at 2,972 of its 2,500-triangle target, within a 3,000-triangle budget.
